SRI LANKA SUSTAINABLE ENERGY AUTHORITY ACT, No. 35 OF 2007
Order under Sub section (1) of Section 12

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Sub section (1) of Section 12 of Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority Act,No. 35 of 2007, I, Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, in consultation with the Ministersin charge of the subject of Mahaweli Development and Environmental, Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, Land, PublicAdministration and Home Affairs, Irrigation and Water Management, Agriculture and Agrarian Services and the Ministersof North Provincial Council to whom the subjects are assigned, do by this Order declare the areas of lands described inthe Schedule hereto as Energy Development Areas in the Jaffna District for the purpose of the aforesaid Act.
RANJITH SIYAMBALAPITIYA,Minister of Power and Renewable Energy.Ministry of Power and Renewale Energy,No. 72, Ananda Kumaraswami Mawatha,Colombo 07,23rd May 2017.SCHEDULE
ENERGY DEVELOPMENT AREAS - WIND POWER
